Clarification mapping:
- No Q<ID> questions were posted in this issue thread.
- `/answer [auto-answered-by-orchestrator]` is interpretable as “proceed with the issue-defined scope without extra constraints.”

Conflict detection (important):
- The requested render-phase behavior is already present in [scripts/validate_process.sh](scripts/validate_process.sh), [scripts/self_heal_validation.sh](scripts/self_heal_validation.sh), [prompts/mode-validate-self-heal.txt](prompts/mode-validate-self-heal.txt), and [tests/test_validate_process_render_recovery.py](tests/test_validate_process_render_recovery.py).
- Mirror drift exists: `.codex-workflow-src/scripts/validate_process.sh` appears older and lacks the render-recovery path now in root scripts. Plan should include parity verification/sync only if `.codex-workflow-src` is in-scope for this issue.

Implementation plan:

1. Files likely to change
- [scripts/validate_process.sh](scripts/validate_process.sh) (only if any gap is found in render recovery entrypoint/call site).
- [scripts/self_heal_validation.sh](scripts/self_heal_validation.sh) (only if render phase tag handling/guardrail logging needs tightening).
- [prompts/mode-validate-self-heal.txt](prompts/mode-validate-self-heal.txt) (only if constraints need wording alignment).
- [tests/test_validate_process_render_recovery.py](tests/test_validate_process_render_recovery.py) and [tests/test_validate_process_template_mode.py](tests/test_validate_process_template_mode.py) for integration/contract coverage.
- Optional parity target if required by release flow: `.codex-workflow-src` equivalents of the above.

2. Functions/modules to implement or verify
- `attempt_render_recovery_after_preflight_failure` in `validate_process.sh`.
- Preflight Phase 2 call path selecting `render` vs `preflight` self-heal phase in `validate_process.sh`.
- `attempt_self_heal_and_reexec` phase normalization (must include `render`).
- Self-heal safety gates in `self_heal_validation.sh` (allow-list and additive-only diff enforcement).
- Prompt guidance/classification for `failing_phase=render` in `mode-validate-self-heal.txt`.

3. Data structures affected
- Preflight runtime state vars: `PRE_FLIGHT_*` (`PRE_FLIGHT_STATUS`, `PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS`, `PRE_FLIGHT_RENDER_RECOVERY_ATTEMPTED`, `PRE_FLIGHT_APPEND_LOG`).
- Self-heal phase tag enum carried via `SELF_HEAL_FAILURE_PHASE` (includes `render`).
- Self-heal decision/ledger JSON shape stays unchanged (`target_prompt`, `failure_class`, `confidence`, `rationale`, `patch`).

4. API/interface changes
- No external API/CLI contract changes.
- Internal behavioral change (already present in root): template-mode lint preflight failure attempts deterministic rerender + relint before terminal/self-heal path.
- Guardrail contract remains: self-heal patches can target only validation prompt files and must be additive-only.

5. Risks/edge cases
- Regressing non-template path (`HARNESS_MODE != template_generate`) must keep legacy `preflight` self-heal routing.
- Recovery loop risk must remain bounded by single rerender attempt (`PRE_FLIGHT_RENDER_RECOVERY_ATTEMPTED`).
- Fail-open behavior on renderer failure/re-lint failure must still reach controlled terminal path without freehand harness edits.
- If `.codex-workflow-src` is required at release time, unsynced mirror can reintroduce old behavior despite root correctness.

6. Testing considerations
- Run targeted integration tests:
  - `pytest -q tests/test_validate_process_render_recovery.py`
  - `pytest -q tests/test_validate_process_template_mode.py`
- Keep existing guardrail behavior covered (no relaxations of allow-list/additive-only checks).
- If mirror sync is in scope, run the same assertions against mirrored artifacts or add parity checks.

Execution checklist:
- [ ] Confirm whether `.codex-workflow-src` parity is in-scope for this issue.
- [ ] Gap-audit root files against acceptance criteria (likely no-op).
- [ ] Apply only minimal delta for any identified gaps.
- [ ] Validate with targeted tests above.
- [ ] If mirror parity is required, sync corresponding `.codex-workflow-src` files and re-run tests.
